eps.o: Ariana Madix welcomes the new Islanders, who get things started with a game of "Lady Luck."
The Islanders must make risky decisions when two mysterious bombshells enter the villa.
Feelings are hurt after a recoupling; some Islanders are turned off after playing "State Your Case."
A secret is revealed, shocking one of the Islanders; a round of "Getting to Fourth Base" is played.
Sophie Monk unpacks the first week in the villa with special guests, including Ariana Madix.
Ariana Madix returns to host the Islanders' first dramatic recoupling.

The Islanders reveal what they really think about each other in a messy game of "Pucker or Pie."
The Islanders play a game of "Dominate Tricks"; three new bombshells are unleashed into the villa.
The new bombshells flirt with the Islanders, threatening the stability of the couples.
Eyal Booker is joined by Season 6 stars JaNa Craig and Serena Page, Ariana Madix and Belle-A.

The Islanders take care of babies for the day; one lucky couple goes to the Hideaway.
The guys leave the villa for a boys' day; America's votes are revealed and a couple is dumped.

Maura Higgins is joined by Chloe Bailey, Justine Ndiba, Liv Walker and the latest dumped couples.

The season 7 cast goes to NYC to hash out all the fun, flirtation and drama from their time in Fiji.
